s.d: Acronym of Just a Bunch of Disks, a collection of hard disks that are not configured according to RAID.
A hard disk enclosure for several disks, especially one lacking a RAID controller.
Initialism of James Bowie High School.
Initialism of Judicial and Bar Council.
Initialism of Joint Bi-level Image Experts Group, a group of experts working on standards for bi-level (usually black and white) image…
An early lossless image compression standard developed by the JBIG, widely implemented in fax machines.
s.e: The JBIG format works well with the many common bilevel images that include text and line art.

s.d: Initialism of John Birch Society, an American right-wing political advocacy group.
Just be white (used sardonically to reflect the belief that white men are greatly advantaged over other men at attracting women)
s.e: ‘JBW’ or ‘Just Be White’—the idea that being white automatically makes you more attractive, particularly to non- white women

s.d: Abbreviation of Java Business Process Model.
